format_summary_policy: The count is the number of distinct readable format labels in the registry, excluding installer-metadata-only types. Use regular secondary text and retain the shortcut to file associations on the right.
recent_menu_policy: Reveal the right disclosure on pointer hover, keyboard focus or while the menu is open. Both parts have independent hover and press states. The list scrolls within the menu, initially showing the newest 20 records. Load more adds up to 20 older records at a time. Clear list stays in the fixed footer.
titlebar_policy: reuse existing main titlebar unchanged; welcome content only
